default.notes: Tourist visa on arrival at Kathmandu airport and land borders: 30 USD/15 days, 50 USD/30 days or 125 USD/90 days, multiple entry, extendable up to 150 days per calendar year.

groups.notes: On the list of nationalities not eligible for visa on arrival — apply for a tourist visa at a Nepali embassy or consulate before travel. Confirm with the nearest Nepali mission.
Tourist visa on arrival; SAARC nationals are eligible for a gratis (free) 30-day visa once per calendar year. Confirm current arrangements before travel.

NP.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Nepali citizens.

IN.notes: No visa needed: under the 1950 India–Nepal treaty the border is open, and Indian citizens may enter, live and work in Nepal with an accepted identity document (passport or voter ID; ID rules apply when flying) — no stay limit.
